units.source_text: 她措词巧妙，将公子的诗意推在女主人身上了。

en.t: She chose her words skillfully, shifting the meaning of the prince's poem onto her mistress.

units.source_text: 当时就有一个眉清目秀的男童，姿态妩媚动人，

en.t: Just then there was a handsome young boy, with graceful and charming bearing,

units.source_text: 像是为这场面特设的人物，

en.t: as if he had been placed there especially for this scene,

units.source_text: 分花拂柳地走进朝雾中，

en.t: and he walked into the morning mist, parting flowers and brushing aside willows,

units.source_text: 听凭露水濡湿裙裾，摘了一朵朝颜花，

en.t: letting the dew soak the hem of his robe as he picked a single morning glory,
then returned and respectfully presented it to Prince Genji.
The scene was so beautiful it could have been painted.

units.source_text: 即使是偶尔拜见一面的人，对源氏公子的美貌无不倾心。

en.t: Even those who had only glimpsed Prince Genji once by chance could not help losing their hearts to his beauty.

units.source_text: 不解情趣的山农野老，休息时也要选择美丽的花木荫下。

en.t: Even rustic farmers and old villagers with no sense of refinement choose the shade of beautiful flowering trees when they rest.

units.source_text: 同理，瞻望过源氏公子风采的人，

en.t: In the same way, those who had looked upon Prince Genji's splendid presence

units.source_text: 都考虑着各人身份，情愿教自己的爱女替公子服役。

en.t: all considered their own rank and gladly wished to have their beloved daughters serve him.

units.source_text: 或者，家有姿色可观的妹妹的人，

en.t: Or those who had younger sisters at home of notable beauty

units.source_text: 无不想把妹妹送到公子身边来当侍女，也不嫌身份卑贱。

en.t: all wanted to send them to the prince's side as attendants, without minding the lowliness of such a position.

units.source_text: 何况中将那样，今日幸得机会，

en.t: How much more so for someone like the Chujo, who had been fortunate enough today

units.source_text: 蒙公子亲口赠诗，目睹公子温柔容姿，

en.t: to receive a poem from the prince's own lips and behold his gentle beauty with her own eyes,

units.source_text: 只要是略解情趣的女子，岂有看作等闲之理？

en.t: for what woman with even a little sense of feeling could possibly regard that as ordinary?

units.source_text: 她担心着公子不肯朝夕光临，开怀畅叙呢。

en.t: She was anxious that the prince might not visit morning and evening and speak with her openly and at ease.
For now, let this matter be set aside.
